description: Outcome-based persistent memory for AI coding tools (Claude Code, OpenCode)
release_notes: v0.6.0: The 4,697-line cli.py monolith is split into a roampal/cli/ package with dispatch-table structural invariants and byte-golden equivalence. Profile-directory bindings: bind a project directory to a profile once (roampal profile bind), with the client resolution contract — every client names its profile (headers, cwd bindings), the shared server never guesses from its own cwd/env, and no app owns the server (idle self-retirement, single-flight down-only restarts, neutral-cwd spawns). Memory length rules live in one module; every write path rejects over-limit text instead of cutting it, and Claude Code's context injection dedups already-seen memories into pointers without losing anything. Full suite: 1019 passed, 4 skipped.
